items.name: lobby
items.prompt: Reference 1 shows the exterior of the hotel: use it for the architectural language, materials and palette. Reference 2 shows the lobby: recreate this exact composition and mood at the highest fidelity and finest detail. Ultra-wide editorial interior photograph of the grand lobby of AURELIA GRAND, perfectly symmetrical, seen from the entrance: a double-height hall with a long central axis of honed travertine floor with fine bronze inlay lines leading to tall arched glass doors in slender dark-bronze frames that open onto the terrace and the sea at golden hour. A monumental sculptural chandelier of hand-blown amber-glass globes on bronze rods hangs above the central seating. Rounded ivory bouclé sofas, low walnut and travertine tables, fluted smoked-oak towers, wall sconces in bronze, a large abstract artwork in sand and bronze tones, an old olive tree in a stone pot. Walls of warm ivory-cream lime plaster, not yellow. Soft golden light from the arched windows mixed with a gentle tungsten glow. Three guests and one staff member in a charcoal jacket far away in the hall, small in the frame. Quiet, majestic, welcoming, luxurious.
